title: Probing an Embodied LLM: When Higher Observation Fidelity Hurts Problem Solving
abstract: arXiv:2605.20072v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as cognitive components for robotic systems, yet their opaque decision processes make it difficult to explain success or failure in closed-loop embodied tasks. Following an empirical AI methodology, we study an embodied LLM agent behaviorally by varying the available information and measuring the resulting changes in behavior. Using the Lockbox, a sequential mechanical puzzle with hidden interdependencies, we evaluate LLMs across RGB, RGB-D, and ground-truth symbolic observations in a physical robotic setup and use simulation to probe the resulting behavior. Counterintuitively, agents perform best under raw RGB input and worst under perfect ground-truth observations. translated_title: 探索具身大语言模型：当更高的观测保真度反而损害问题解决能力时
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被提议作为机器人系统的认知组件，然而其不透明的决策过程使得难以解释闭环具身任务中的成功或失败。遵循实证AI方法论，我们通过改变可用信息并测量由此产生的行为变化，对具身LLM智能体进行行为学研究。使用Lockbox（一个具有隐藏相互依赖关系的顺序机械谜题），我们在物理机器人设置中评估了LLM在RGB、RGB-D和真实符号观测下的表现，并利用仿真来探究由此产生的行为。与直觉相反，智能体在原始RGB输入下表现最好，而在完美的真实观测下表现最差。在仿真中，我们通过随机翻转感知到的动作结果来探究这一效应，发现适度的噪声能够提升性能，在40%的翻转概率下达到峰值，成功率相比……提升了2.85倍。
tldr: 该研究发现具身大语言模型智能体在原始RGB输入下问题解决表现最佳、而在完美的真实观测下表现最差，且适度的感知噪声（40%翻转概率）反而能将成功率提升2.85倍，挑战了“观测保真度越高越好”的直觉。
en_tdlr: This study finds that embodied LLM agents perform best with raw RGB input and worst with perfect ground-truth observations, and that moderate perceptual noise (40% flip probability) improves the success rate by 2.85-fold, challenging the intuition that higher observation fidelity is always better.
